fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: User cache, keyed by path (Recommended): os.UserCacheDir()/genesis/index/<hash of worktree root>.db, as the conversation described; keeps .genesis clean and puts every repo's index in one place for the later cross-repo view; orphaned when a worktree moves (harmless).

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: Input-incremental (Recommended): Only new entry files are read and decoded, only touched change sets are refolded, and a view (as-is, to-be) is recomputed whole in memory only when its set of change sets or their ops changed, then written by diff; uses internal/model unchanged.
fields.statement: Input-incremental: read and decode only new entry files, refold touched change sets, recompute a view whole in memory with `internal/model` only when its inputs changed, write its rows by diff.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 5 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: As-is + to-be stored (Recommended): Materialize both as rows (nodes, links, problems per view); what-if for one change set is computed on demand in memory from the stored folded change sets via model.WhatIf, and its cost is benchmarked and reported.
fields.statement: As-is and to-be materialized; what-if computed on demand from stored entries via `model.WhatIf`, its cost benchmarked.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 5 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.statement: Freshness by entry file names; new names catch up incrementally; any vanished name → full rebuild; content edits are `check`'s job.

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: Rebuild; wait on locks (Recommended): Schema version in PRAGMA user_version: mismatch or a corrupt/unopenable file → delete and rebuild from the log. Catch-up runs in BEGIN IMMEDIATE with WAL and a busy timeout (~5 s), re-checking freshness once it holds the lock; a timeout is an error, never a silent half-update.
fields.statement: Failures: schema version in `PRAGMA user_version`; mismatch or corrupt/unopenable → delete and rebuild. Catch-up in `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`, WAL, busy timeout 5 s, freshness re-checked under the lock; a timeout is an error.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 5 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: Minimal core (Recommended): Per view: Node, Resolve (ID, unique prefix ≥4, live handle), Children, Ancestors (recursive CTE), Links from/to a node; plus ChangeSets (folded, with state), entries of a change set, and all problems (log, fold, model). Enough to benchmark realistic reads.
fields.statement: Query API, per view: Node, Resolve (full ID, unique prefix ≥ 4, live handle), Children, Ancestors, Links from/to; plus ChangeSets (with state), Entries of a change set, Problems (log, fold, model).

Fixed in PR #11 (3b5d1da); the benchmarks still report the tighter numbers.

Skipped under -short.
fields.statement: Threshold: median < 50 ms over 20 runs of the fresh-read path (milestone 1's read target; revised from 25 ms in PR #11); skipped under `-short`.
